QUOTE: "Its own allocator is a client of it. `mbedtls_memory_buffer_alloc_init(buf, len)` (`library/memory_buffer_alloc.c:566`) does not call libc. It calls `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free` with its own `buffer_alloc_calloc_mutexed`"
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the buffer allocator calls the setter from its init function, but never says it is the only in-tree user, and it doesn't name MBEDTLS_MEMORY_BUFFER_ALLOC_C.
